_설명: 천일문 2권 워크북 Chapter 03 조동사의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 기본 7과 조동사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 같은 의미로 쓰인 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> You [[may]] get lost. Take a map with you.

choices.text: [[May]] I borrow your pen for a second?
The test [[may]] not be easy for you.
[[May]] I go home earlier than usual today?
You [[may]] not take photos inside the museum.
You [[may]] have a short rest now.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: 우리는 건강을 위해 아침을 먹어야 한다.
→ We ________ eat breakfast for our health.

choices.text: may
must
can’t
will
may not

questions.point_label: 과거의 의무 had to와 과거의 능력 could
questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • I stayed up late last night. I ____(A)____ finish my report.
• They ____(B)____ smell the flowers when they walked in the garden yesterday.

choices.text: must — can
must — could
have to — could
had to — could
had to — can

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 한 단어로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: I was glad because I [[was able to]] meet my cousin last weekend.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 must의 의미가 나머지와 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: That bakery [[must]] be popular. There’s a long line.
You [[must]] follow the safety rules in the lab.
You [[must]] ask your parents first.
You [[must]] wear a helmet on the bike.
We [[must]] tidy the classroom before the teacher comes.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: Mia don’t have to leave early today.
They doesn’t have to clean the windows.
I don’t had to bring an umbrella now.
He didn’t have to feed the cat yesterday.
You don’t have to eating all the bread if you’re full.

questions.point_label: must not과 don’t have to의 구별
questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 <보기>에서 골라 순서대로 바르게 연결한 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> ⓐ must not   ⓑ don’t have to   ⓒ doesn’t have to
(A) They ________ come to work next Monday. It is a holiday.
(B) She ________ run in the hallway.
(C) Jinho ________ wash the dishes because his sister has already done them.

questions.prompt: 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어색한 것을 고르세요.
body: A: Is there anything wrong with you?
B: I have a bad headache and feel dizzy.

choices.text: Get some rest right now.
You have to see a doctor right now.
You’d better see a doctor right now.
You should see a doctor right now.
You will see a doctor right now.

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분과 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 문장 두 개를 고르세요.
body: A: Can I open the window now?
B: [[No, don’t do that.]] It’s too noisy outside.

choices.text: You have to open the window now.
You must not open the window now.
You had better open the window now.
You should not open the window now.
You don’t have to open the window now.

questions.point_label: had better의 부정은 had better not
questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 바르게 고쳐 문장을 다시 쓰세요.
body: We had not better swim in the deep water.
questions.answer: We had better not swim in the deep water.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 바르게 고쳐 문장을 다시 쓰세요.
body: I would like to visiting the museum with you.
questions.answer: I would like to visit the museum with you.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: 소라는 집에 일찍 돌아와야 한다. → Sora have to come back home early.
너는 잔디밭에 들어가면 안 된다. → You don’t have to walk on the grass.
그 박물관의 표는 비쌀지도 모른다. → The museum’s ticket may be expensive.
저기 있는 여자는 그의 어머니가 아닐지도 모른다. → The woman over there can be his mother.
나는 매일 운동할 것이다. → I can exercise every day.

questions.prompt: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 문맥상 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: Online classes are very convenient. We just turn on the computer or tablet, and join the class with a single click. We ________ travel to school.

choices.text: should
could not
don’t have to
must not
should not

questions.prompt: 다음은 일기문입니다. 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고친 것으로 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: Sunday, August 5
The hiking trip was awful. We ⓐ [[can’t]] ⓑ [[reached]] the top because of the thick fog. So, we ⓒ [[have to]] ⓓ [[came]] down early. We will ⓔ [[planned]] a better trip next time.

choices.text: ⓐ can’t → couldn’t
ⓑ reached → reach
ⓒ have to → had to
ⓓ came → coming
ⓔ planned → plan
